sets.notes: Singular: Fakir. Historically the Arabic word denotes a Muslim mendicant; the bed-of-nails image is the popular European usage the card relies on.

sets.notes: The mercenary sense of „free lance“ was popularised by Walter Scott's Ivanhoe (1819), which set it in the Middle Ages; the compound itself is not attested in medieval English. The card's framing is the popular one.
